findings.text: the head-run aggregate opens with the base-run control string and the label "# aggregate red-at-base run" and names no revision, tree or command, while the per-file head logs it wraps open "# revision after" — a phase tag, not a sha — so the artifact cited for the 119-pass result does not identify the content measured, and a reader taking that first line at face value reads the base revision as having been tested; the fix is in the runner, logs/run-red.sh, which hardcodes the red header for both phases.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 77c20349; 7ff63a7d is fixture-only — the _ensure_ledger helper at tests/test_a_served_run_is_not_silence.py:60, eight one-line ledger.write initialisations, allow_create=True at tests/test_store_concurrency.py:47, and the equality-to-substring assertion at tests/test_a_served_run_is_not_silence.py:165 — and 238f5e77 is docs-only, so the reviewed head's test content is exactly what the gate measured, with no production file touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the measure is each owned file in its own pytest process with its own --basetemp on compute, every listed id passing or named, no id moving pass to fail, cause and class per repaired id, and a red log per file; the manifest records that command and the 119/0 result at 7ff63a7d, logs/base77c20349-*.log carry exactly the 53 listed ids red, and the run's stream.jsonl holds the compute receipt (hostname 98dci4-clu-2058.iter.org, SLURM_JOB_ID 1277272, TMPDIR=/tmp), though the head aggregate the manifest cites does not name the revision it measured.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that the eleven red files this node owns pass at head; at head 238f5e77 all eleven pass with 119 passed / 0 failed / 0 errors, and the 53 node ids §4 lists for this node (docs/research/suite-failures-at-head.html#s4) are exactly the 53 that failed at base 77c20349 — no listed id missing and none unlisted, with per-file base (passed + failed) equal to head passed (66 + 53 = 119).
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the run directory; it records status complete, both commits, the per-file gate with its logs and the red-at-base path, cause and class for every repaired id, and its stated result (119 passed / 0 failed at 7ff63a7d) matches the after-*.log set I read, as does its zero-added lint delta (6 findings at base, 6 at head), which I reproduced.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared fence is the eleven test files, docs/plans/the-suite-is-green-at-head.html, docs/evidence/archive/the-suite-is-green-at-head-landed.html and docs/figures/the-suite-is-green-at-head; git diff --name-status 77c20349..238f5e77 lists thirteen paths, every one inside it, the figures directory is untouched, and the plan-version and plan-modified meta lines are not edited.

justifications.durability: reverting 7ff63a7d reddens the exact 53 ids at base (logs/base77c20349-*.log) and the substring assertion at tests/test_a_served_run_is_not_silence.py:165-169 compares an independent literal against the product's reason, failing if the cause is lost — though the record's "not weakened" claim holds for coverage (no test lost: base 66 passed + 53 failed = head 119) and not for strictness, since that assertion is looser than the equality it replaced.
justifications.evidence: the gate is exactly the done_when's measure and its result is recorded and independently reproduced here — 53/53 listed ids red at base in logs/base77c20349-*.log, 119/0 at head, per-file base (passed + failed) equal to head passed — but the head artifact the manifest cites, logs/after-aggregate.log:1, opens with the base-run control string and names no revision, tree or command, and the per-file head logs it wraps open "# revision after", so the record does not identify the content measured.
justifications.fit: the helper and the writes follow the module's own idiom — ledger.ledger_path(...).exists() guarding a ledger.write of the exact empty shape ledger.load returns (reckon/ledger.py:645) — and no file introduces a plan label or a banned name, though the plan's landing section omits the inert section-landed class its sibling s1 carries, which nothing under docs/ui or docs/_shared reads.
justifications.goal_fidelity: all eleven owned files pass at their head (logs/after-*.log) and the repair moves the fixtures to the shipped refusal as the plan's stale-expectation decision requires (docs/plans/the-suite-is-green-at-head.html#s2) rather than editing product code, though the exhaustion assertion is now looser than the equality it replaced.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-status 77c20349..238f5e77 shows thirteen paths, all inside the declared fence, the cumulative evidence anchor is a new file so no peer section was overwritten, and the single deletion in docs is the plan's blank separator line.
